**Finding: missing — insurance clause absent (severity low).**

- No insurance language exists anywhere in the agreement (full-text search returned nothing), and the three candidate sections — 5.3 Security, 14.12 Risk of Loss, 14.18 Data Protection — address security disclaimers, risk of loss allocation and data processing only.
- IBM hosts the e-business Hosting Environment and processes personal information on our behalf, so this is exactly the vendor profile the rule targets; no coverage at all is walk-away territory.
- Inserted a short preferred-position clause as 14.12A (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, workers' comp, certificates on request), with the E&O 1M / cyber 2M fallback offered in the negotiation comment.
